content_review: Definitions retained: DPS arbitrates protection; SC operates, monitors and logs; local interlocks remain independent.
Facility overview routes FFDG, SDSTA and the single CUC cryogenic system through SC; SC/DPS use OPC UA.
BMS slides include schematic vertical service boundaries at 4850/4910; licence and SDSTA survey status remain explicit.
Matrix review precedes DPS logic and the Detector divider. Each proposed inhibit is traced from source through input, decision, actuator/load and feedback.
BDE design and VD rack counts retained; fan-to-bias dependency is conditional and historical HD evidence is distinguished from VD requirements.
DAPHNE main diagram adapts the working ICD and includes DAQ; full service diagram is retained in backup.
PoF uses the confirmed four voltage readings plus one temperature per box: 320 voltage plus 80 temperature readings. PDU inhibition and optional box enable remain distinct.
HV, CalCI thermometry, lasers and purity monitors have separate slides. Proposed laser and PrM rules and the PrM ICD conflict remain visible.
Rack infrastructure is separate; PDS LV scope is 34 feeds; TDE current control is PDU-only across 20 racks, with potential future interfaces retained.
June 2027 hardware/procurement readiness and early-2028 full VD response-matrix review are retained.
limits: Presentation and source review only; no installed wiring, controller logic or end-to-end response time has been qualified.
The interlock review is ongoing. No complete additions bill of materials or proven spare-I/O count is claimed.
BMS maps show service boundaries, not surveyed cross-sections or installed point inventories. SDSTA interfaces remain under investigation.
Local working ICDs and notes include proposals and unresolved conflicts. Source revisions are pinned locally; no fresh EDMS latest-version check was performed.
CUC DPS location and work assignments remain proposals. The PoF monitoring count does not establish the number of physical laser drivers or central DPS terminals.
Build used local fonts and included PDF 1.6 material in a PDF 1.5 output setting; warnings were recorded. Visual rendering passed.
